target_customer: UPSC civil services aspirants in India who pay for an AI mentor instead of coaching
problem: Quality UPSC coaching costs more than Rs 1 lakh a year and offers little personal feedback. SuperKalam offers doubt solving, Mains answer evaluation and practice at a lower price.
business_model: Consumer subscription (SUPER plan priced at Rs 6,499 until Mains per the site) with a limited free trial
product_category: AI test prep mentor for UPSC

founders.background_notes: YC page says founding team member and growth leader at Unacademy. Education not found.

technical_complexity.rationale: Language model based tutoring and answer evaluation grounded in a UPSC syllabus corpus; the hard part is accuracy and evaluation quality, using models available in 2023.

defensibility.rationale: General chat tools can answer UPSC questions, so the edge is curated content, habit features such as streaks and community, and a niche focus; each is replicable.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Large edtech players and later PW and others added AI features (PW cites AI mains preparation in 2026 pages). No acquisition of SuperKalam found.

market_need_then: Millions of UPSC aspirants spend heavily on coaching. The site compares its price to coaching at Rs 1 lakh and ChatGPT Pro at about Rs 20,000. No dated third party demand figure was opened.

branding.domain_note: Uses superkalam.com, exact match dot com.

identity.visual_style: Clean and simple, Indian State Emblem in the footer
identity.voice_and_tone: Friendly, motivational, discipline and daily streak themes with emojis

branding.brand_signature: Tagline Your Personal AI Mentor with daily streak and accountability framing
branding.community_and_virality: The site has a Community section and testimonials, with no independent evidence of memes or merch.

brand_strength.rationale: Kalam is a word with strong meaning in Indian education, and super implies capability, but no source explains the name or shows brand driven growth.

outcome_analysis: SuperKalam focused on one exam, UPSC, and led by a former Unacademy growth leader raised a $2M seed in May 2024 led by YC and FundersClub with a team of 20. The product is live with pricing and no exit or layoffs were found. Growth data is not public, so the strength of product market fit is unverified.
notes: The seed is confirmed by Inc42, Outlook Business and Entrackr (about Rs 16.3 to 16.6 crore). CB Insights shows $4M over four rounds and another aggregator $2.53M, unverified; an earlier pre-seed from YC is not separately sourced. Startupintros names a different lead (Boris Silver and Puneet Kumar), treated as less reliable. The date of the seed varies between 22 and 23 May 2024, so only the month is recorded. Competitor items are dated 2022 and are the nearest dated entries found.
